correctness.rationale: Spherical area coordinates have t=x3 uniform on [m-h,m+h] and azimuth uniform. The first and second moment tensor T=diag((1-u-z/3)/2,(1-u-z/3)/2,u+z/3) yields M=2(1-u) and V=4(tr(T²)-u²). Conditional independence given X1 yields C=4uz/3. Completing square V=4/3-4u²+(2/3)(z-(1-3u))². The fold z*=1-3u is strictly interior to (0,(1-sqrt(u))²] exactly for 1/4<u<1/3, giving two widths but at most two; u=3/10 and z=3/50,7/50 yield M=7/5,V=609/625 and C=3/125,7/125. When u>0, z=3C/(4u); u=0 uses V=4/3+2(1-z)²/3 to recover z. Correct across caps, whole sphere, and centered zones, with h>0 and reflection ambiguity. Inspected pinned proof and exact rational checker, independently verified tensor identities and witness; no extrapolation from Monte Carlo.
